AFRP Strategy

The strategy documents

Every document the Federation's strategy is built from, from the 2018 analysis to the 2026 draft, with what each one holds.

40 documents

These are the Strategic Planning Committee's own documents. Each title links to the file in the Federation's shared drive. The links open only for people with access to AFRP's drive; anyone else will be asked to request access.

This page carries a short summary of each document and never its text, because several of them name living people (D50). The tag under each title is the short name the crosswalk uses for it.

Committee rosters and contact lists are kept in the same drive and are deliberately not listed here.
